- **[刘亦菲自剪头发上热搜](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTFBLa0RGcndEenJKcmtQVEZyeGxHUXcwcml0c05NWW5tRWE4RWM4VkdDcmlVM2c2UHdHZHctRWNkN3BQNkNyTlluSm1zdzF2cFdCVmIyQ2tQTGZsRmo2WUhFcE16QQ)**：一段居家剪发视频获百万点赞，网友称赞其真实感。
- **[陈都灵黑色战国袍一舞封神](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiT0FVX3lxTE1rVUU5RFZwUms3dHVGZl9fQ3Q0Z3Fna2Rvck0td2dRNU45dEVMNTRBR240anZab2gycjhyT0tja09UQk1GbEhGSDZqOVB0NkU)**：新综艺中一段战国袍舞蹈被剪成多个热搜二创，国风美学再次破圈。
- **[BLG选手Bin哥拒绝与粉丝击掌](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMif0FVX3lxTE9vTWJaQVVzXzVFLWZaaWdnSlZBYjgwVFk1Ql94TVBTN1E4R0dxcWhTZlFZdkJyZk0xOFVkNk1JYjJtUVZnSEx2am1BRk5oQm5PZFpNY1pYQUtjMlgyMG5iWXZaaWk3NWtGb2lVNnVFU3ota0tzRTdTV1E1UE5XaUk)**：比赛入场环节全程黑脸，粉丝不满其态度。俱乐部尚未回应。

收束：微博生态中，「人设」与「真实」的区隔日益模糊，明星任何微表情都可能被放大解读，而「反转」本身已成为新的流量来源。
微博社区动态.en:
Chinese social media buzzed with a mix of celebrity gossip, viral trends, and esports drama. Actor Han Dong live-streamed crying about lack of roles, then clarified it wasn't serious—sparking a debate on authenticity. Actress Xi Mengyao's wedding dress sparked controversy due to 'sensitive year' timing. Chen Duling's new drama 'Qiaochu' and her dance in black Warring States robe trended. Oddly, a 'live lychee vs. dead lychee' food safety topic also hit the top trends. BLG esports player Bin's refusal to high-five fans sparked criticism.

资本市场传来暖意：中信系连续两日溢价买入华谊兄弟，被视为对影视寒冬见底的赌注。内容制作端，《冰川时代6》官宣2027年2月北美档期，经典IP续命延续好莱坞策略；中央芭蕾舞团全明星阵容《天鹅湖》宣布秋季回归，显示高雅艺术市场复苏。此外，河北科技大学巴黎电影学院获批，中法影视教育合作迈出实质一步。

- **[中信系悄然入局华谊兄弟](https://news.google.)**：连续两日溢价，单日成交额超1.2亿元。市场猜测中信将推动华谊与旗下影视资源整合。
- **[《冰川时代6》发布海报](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiWEFVX3lxTE9zRUIxXzB6LWpscE9zQ1pwN08zR0hCeW40OVNsZWV5YWV4ZHR6dzhVMGVXaG95YWFzbnJ6OHo4c2FadlAwRHdZWjhBanRZRERHZ1VfcXZYcGo)**：迪士尼/20世纪影业宣布续作，猛犸象曼尼等角色回归。北美定档2027年2月。
- **[中央芭蕾舞团《天鹅湖》焕新回归](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiVEFVX3lxTFAxR1g5dUk0V0RnTGFTQ2dNQnY2WVBxc1pnbFViTF9abFJSc2Z4N2d2UHF0UU8td0xZUHlYalY0M1pqU2ZsN0dUbDBwYmZKQnN2ZzJXaQ)**：启用全明星阵容，编舞融合现代元素，北京天桥剧场9月开演。
- **[河北科技大学巴黎电影学院获批](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMibEFVX3lxTE4teEJWckM0aUxGb3hSekRGT2E3dTlHTzdpczFnSFg2cFNvaWRFQ3Z3UW9LT0pFNnl0THlybUZrME1IY29PbUlmVFhSRTVfUVM5Ry1IWjQyT2ZMcUhMUl9KS2dLeW45bE9SSkY4eA)**：与法国巴黎电影学院合作，本科学位，计划2027年招生。

收束：华谊的资本动向比单一作品更能反映行业信心，而教育合作则暗示中国影视业正向「产学研」体系转型，但成效需时间检验。

Mainland China entertainment news covered a mix of international Hollywood releases, industry partnerships, and cultural events. 'Ice Age 6' announced for February 2027 in North America. Thailand's incentives for foreign film crews are yielding results. Huayi Brothers saw premium buying from CITIC, hinting at investor confidence. The Central Ballet revived 'Swan Lake' with full cast. Academic initiatives like the Hebei University-Paris Film School and 'Lights of China' lectures highlight educational expansions. Perfect World Pictures showcased works at the UN's Palais des Nations.

- **'Ice Age 6' Poster Release**: Set for February 2027 North American release ([China Entertainment Network](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiWEFVX3lxTE9zRUIxXzB6LWpscE9zQ1pwN08zR0hCeW40OVNsZWV5YWV4ZHR6dzhVMGVXaG95YWFzbnJ6OHo4c2FadlAwRHdZWjhBanRZRERHZ1VfcXZYcGo)).
- **Huayi Brothers Stock Surge**: CITIC enters Huayi with premium bids for two consecutive days ([Sina Finance](https://news.google.)).
- **Central Ballet's 'Swan Lake' Returns**: Full star cast performance ([hkong.cn](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiVEFVX3lxTFAxR1g5dUk0V0RnTGFTQ2dNQnY2WVBxc1pnbFViTF9abFJSc2Z4N2d2UHF0UU8td0xZUHlYalY0M1pqU2ZsN0dUbDBwYmZKQnN2ZzJXaQ)).
- **New Film School Collaboration**: Hebei University and Paris Film Academy approved ([Education Online](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMibEFVX3lxTE4teEJWckM0aUxGb3hSekRGT2E3dTlHTzdpczFnSFg2cFNvaWRFQ3Z3UW9LT0pFNnl0THlybUZrME1IY29PbUlmVFhSRTVfUVM5Ry1IWjQyT2ZMcUhMUl9KS2dLeW45bE9SSkY4eA)).
- **Perfect World at UN**: Chinese animation exhibited at Geneva ([East Money](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiswFBVV95cUxPWThUdElHbTdSM1BFbm96UlZsQWgtNmV0V29HQmcxTDc5c1RXd09HeWUtd09oQVZ4cDRoWXBJVlFSN3JfYUMxRHpQQ1U0aVFiRXh2WDJSc19HVnkwdWNiaF9SeDFaYkNJelVVVE14dGJLTG5CZDhNTklCRTBONy1ibUp2YUZYUzBRM0daUHZWTFdrY1JaakhHOG1pa1QxVlpQMF9nSV84VzFrYXpEOHF0M0JNYw)).

Huayi Brothers' financial move and the Ice Age sequel indicate ongoing global integration, while cultural institutions push for soft power through film and ballet.
